messages:
jordan: Quick sync — need to finalize POC success criteria with Acme before EOW. They care about latency, cost, and hallucination rate. Who can own prompt set + golden examples?

maya: I can own the golden set. Need expected QPS and target p50/p95 latency from product. Do we use their 100k token sample or a smaller slice for the pilot?

samir: Recommend we propose targets rather than ask — suggest p50 < 50ms, p95 < 200ms on Dedicated for their interactive flows. For hallucination gating propose entity extraction precision >95% on golden set.

lee: Heads up: procurement already asked about dedicated pricing delta vs hosted. I sketched a draft pricing band (reserved 4x GPUs + enterprise support). Will drop spreadsheet in thread.

jordan: @maya please draft 100 golden prompts (10 per top intent) and ~50 adversarial negatives so we can test hallucinations/regressions.

maya: Working on prompts. One question: do we score with BLEU, ROUGE, or use token-level F1 + human pass/fail? I vote F1 for entities + intent accuracy for automation.

samir: Agreed. Our plan: automatic metrics for continuous regression, and a small human review for edge cases. Proposed rubric:
```
- intent accuracy >= 92%
- entity F1 >= 95%
- hallucination rate <= 1.5% measured on golden set
- latency p95 <= 200ms (dedicated)
```
Also add regression gate: any metric drop >2% triggers rollback and investigation.

jordan: Security questionnaire status? Anything blocking on privacy/residency?

secbot: security: SSO + SCIM supported; encryption at rest in transit confirmed. Data residency flagged — Acme requires EU-only storage for PII. Private deployment (VPC/Private) recommended. See doc: https://drive.redwood/sec/acme-sq.pdf

lee: EU-only requirement is an enterprise blocker unless they accept Hosted EU region + contractual guarantees. @jordan can you surface to AE and confirm budget for Private deploy?

jordan: Yep. I'll escalate to AE and procurement. Timeline proposed: pilot start next Mon, run 2 weeks for core metrics, then optional 4-week extended eval if metrics are green.

maya: For the eval harness I'll push prompt CSV + labels to repo. Proposed harness config:
```
scoring:
  auto: [intent_accuracy, entity_f1]
  human_sample: 200
  seed: 42
```
Need approval on human_sample size.

samir: Add one more thing — include a quantized model variant to run cost/latency tradeoffs. Redwood Optimize should produce batching and quantization suggestions and an expected $/1k calls estimate.

jordan: :thumbsup: Nice. Action items recap:
- maya: golden prompts + labeled CSV by Thu
- samir: scoring config + regression gate doc (include thresholds + rollback playbook)
- lee: finalize pricing sheet and EU deployment feasibility note
- jordan: escalate security/residency to AE/procurement and confirm pilot kickoff
I'll follow up in this thread and sync with @acme-poc.

maya: Adding initial files to repo now: https://git.redwood/poc/acme/preflight — will DM if I need sample logs or ground truth.
